questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a captive breeding programme?

options.text: Releasing pesticides to control pest populations
Breeding endangered animals in zoos with the aim of reintroducing them to the wild
Selectively breeding farm animals for higher meat yield
Keeping pets at home for companionship

questions.explanation: Captive breeding programmes involve breeding endangered species in controlled environments such as zoos, with the goal of increasing population numbers and eventually reintroducing individuals back into their natural habitat.
